TARNWICK COUNTY TREASURER
Property Tax Division

Statement date: October 12, 2026

Owner of record: Nadia Ferreira-Stroud
Parcel number: 07-2219-004-0310
Property location: 418 Linnet Row
Assessed value: $184,300

2026 REAL PROPERTY TAX - SECOND INSTALLMENT REMINDER

Dear Property Owner,

The second installment of the 2026 real property tax on the parcel listed above is now payable.

  Second installment amount due:   $1,406.27
  Due date:                        December 1, 2026

Our records show that your first installment was received on April 27, 2026 and was paid in full. Nothing further is owed on the first installment.

How to pay

Online: Visit the Tarnwick County tax payment portal and search by parcel number. Payment by electronic check is free. Card payments carry a service fee that is charged by the card processor and shown before you confirm.

By mail: Send a check or money order payable to Tarnwick County Treasurer, together with the enclosed payment coupon. Write the parcel number on your check. A mailed payment is on time if it is postmarked on or before December 1, 2026.

In person: The Treasurer's counter in the County Administration Building accepts checks, money orders and cards during business hours.

If the installment is not paid on time

Any part of the second installment that is unpaid after December 1, 2026 becomes delinquent. A penalty of 10 percent of the unpaid amount is added at that time, and interest of 1 percent per month is charged on the unpaid tax from then until it is paid.

If you no longer own this property, please forward this statement to the new owner or return it to our office.

Tarnwick County Treasurer
Property Tax Division

CITY OF PELLERTON POLICE DEPARTMENT
Alarm Administration Unit

Notice date: October 13, 2026

Permit holder: Emeka Lindqvist
Alarm permit number: AP-118264
Protected address: 62 Cordwainer Street

NOTICE OF FALSE ALARM FEE

Dear Emeka Lindqvist,

Officers were sent to the protected address at 2:47 a.m. on October 4, 2026 in response to a signal from your alarm system. They checked the building and found no sign of a break-in, attempted entry or other emergency. Under the City's alarm ordinance the response has been recorded as a false alarm.

1. Fee assessed. This was the third false alarm recorded at this address during your current permit year. The first two false alarms in a permit year carry no charge. A fee of $75.00 has been assessed for this one.

2. When payment is due. The fee must be paid within 30 days of the date of this notice.

3. How to pay. You may pay online through the City's alarm permit portal using your permit number, or mail a check payable to the City of Pellerton to the Alarm Administration Unit. Do not send cash. To be on time, your payment must reach us by the due date of November 20, 2026.

4. If the fee is not paid. A late charge of $25.00 will be added and your alarm permit will be suspended. While a permit is suspended, officers are not sent in response to an alarm signal from the address unless someone at the scene confirms that an emergency is taking place.

5. If you disagree. If you believe the alarm was caused by an actual or attempted crime, you may ask for a review by writing to the Alarm Administrator and explaining why. Include any report or photographs that support your request. The fee remains payable while a review is pending.

We encourage you to have your alarm company inspect the system. Most false alarms are caused by user error or by equipment that needs service.

Alarm Administration Unit
City of Pellerton Police Department

NOTICE OF CHANGE - PLEASE READ THIS FIRST

The reporting date and place printed in Part 1 of this summons were set before the schedule for repairs to the main courthouse was final. Both have changed.

  Report on:   Monday, November 9, 2026 at 8:15 a.m.
  Report to:   Halverstoke County Courthouse, 1 Court Square, Jury Assembly Room 2B

Bring this summons and government-issued photo identification when you report. After 5:00 p.m. on the evening before your reporting date, call the juror information line or check the juror portal to confirm that your group is still needed.

Jury service is a legal duty. A juror who does not report as directed, and who has not been excused by the Court, may be ordered to appear before a judge to explain the absence and may be fined up to $250.00.

Jury Services

Licensed and insured. Serving the Aldersea Valley since 1998.

Invoice no. 2026-0473
October 12, 2026

Bill to: Harriet Okonjo-Bell
Job address: 19 Sexton Close

Dear Ms. Okonjo-Bell,

Thank you for having us out. The work at your home was finished on October 8, 2026, and I went up myself the next morning to check it. The new crown has set properly, the flashing is tight, and the cap is seated and screwed down on all four sides. Photos from before and after are enclosed with this letter for your records.

Rental agreement: 3-C114-2291

NOTICE OF DEFAULT AND LIEN SALE

Mateo Halvorsen:

YOUR ACCOUNT IS IN DEFAULT. Rent for the unit listed above was due on the first of the month and has not been paid. Under your rental agreement and the state self-service storage law, Brindlow Self Storage holds a lien on everything stored in the unit for unpaid rent and charges.

Charges on your account as of the date of this notice:

  October rent              $124.00
  Late fee                   $20.00
  Lien notice fee            $15.00
  Total now due             $159.00

Access to the unit has been suspended, and our lock has been placed on the door. It will be removed when the account is paid.

To end the default and keep your property, you must pay $169.00 in full no later than October 30, 2026. Payment has to be made at the facility office in cash, by money order or by card. We cannot take a personal check on an account that is in default, and a partial payment will not stop the sale.

IF THE FULL AMOUNT IS NOT PAID BY OCTOBER 30, 2026, THE CONTENTS OF THE UNIT WILL BE SOLD AT PUBLIC AUCTION ON OR AFTER NOVEMBER 14, 2026 TO SATISFY THE LIEN. Money from the sale is applied first to what you owe and to the costs of the sale. Anything left over is held for you for one year. Property that cannot be sold may be thrown away.

If you are on active military duty, or you believe this notice was sent in error, contact the facility manager in writing before October 30, 2026.

Brindlow Self Storage
Facility Manager, Facility 3

ESKERFIELD PARKS AND RECREATION DISTRICT
Youth Programs Office

October 13, 2026

To: Simone Drakeford
Household account: H-20931
Participant: Eli Drakeford
Program: Winter Youth Basketball, Grades 3-4

Subject: Your registration payment was returned

Dear Simone,

Thank you for signing Eli up for winter basketball. I am writing because the check you gave us for the registration fee (check number 1187, for $145.00) came back from your bank unpaid on October 9, 2026. That means Eli's registration has not been paid for yet.

We would like to keep Eli in the program, so please replace the payment as soon as you can. The amount needed is $170.00. That is the $145.00 registration fee plus the District's $25.00 returned-payment fee, which we have to charge whenever a bank sends a payment back.

Because the first payment was returned, we are not able to accept another check for this balance. You can pay by card through your online household account, or you can come to the front desk at the Eskerfield Community Center and pay by card, cash or money order.

For now we are holding Eli's place. Coaches are being assigned and teams will be drawn up soon. Once the teams are set, any registration that is still unpaid is cancelled and the place goes to the next child on the waiting list. I cannot tell you exactly which day that will be, so please do not put this off.

If paying the whole amount at once would be a hardship for your family, talk to us before you pay. The District has a fee assistance fund for youth programs, and the application is short.

Warm regards,

Dale Ruskin-Amato
Youth Programs Coordinator
Eskerfield Parks and Recreation District

FERNSBY & COATE GROCERS, INC.
Payroll Department

October 14, 2026

Leocadia Brennan-Voss
Reference: UP-2026-0388

Re: Uncashed wages - we need to hear from you

Dear Leocadia Brennan-Voss,

Our payroll records show that a paycheck issued to you has never been cashed:

  Check number:   204417
  Check date:     August 18, 2023
  Net amount:     $312.07
  Description:    Final pay, Harlow Street store

This money belongs to you. We are writing because state law treats wages that have gone unclaimed for three years as abandoned property. Unless we hear from you, we are required to report the amount and hand it over to the State Treasurer's Unclaimed Property Division.

To claim your wages directly from us, complete and sign the enclosed Owner Response Form and return it so that we receive it by December 7, 2026. The form asks you to confirm your current mailing address. You can send it back in the enclosed envelope, or scan it and use the secure upload link printed on the form.

Once we have your form, we will cancel the old check and mail a replacement for $312.07 to the address you give us, normally within 15 business days. If you still have the original check, please do not try to deposit it. It is too old to be honored and your bank is likely to reject it.

If we do not receive your form by December 7, 2026, the $312.07 will be sent to the State Treasurer with our annual report. You will not lose the money, but you would then have to file a claim with the Unclaimed Property Division to get it, and we would no longer be able to pay you ourselves.

There is no fee for responding, and you do not owe the company anything. This is not a request for payment.

Payroll Department
Fernsby & Coate Grocers, Inc.

WE HAVE RECEIVED YOUR DISPUTE

Dear Caoimhe Stavros,

We received your dispute of the toll invoice listed above on October 6, 2026. You told us that the vehicle shown in the photographs had been sold before the dates of travel.

For reference, the invoice you are disputing shows:

  Tolls for 3 crossings, September 2 to 5, 2026    $11.75
  Administrative fees                              $35.00
  Invoice total                                    $46.75

What happens now

The invoice has been placed on hold. While your dispute is under review you do not need to pay it, no further fees will be added, and it will not be sent to collections. You do not need to do anything else at this time.

We will mail you a written decision within 45 days of the date we received your dispute, which means by November 20, 2026.

If the reviewer needs something more from you, we will write and explain what is needed. You would then have 15 days from the date of that letter to reply.

How the review can end

If your dispute is approved, the invoice will be cancelled and you will owe nothing.

If your dispute is denied in whole or in part, the decision letter will state the amount that remains payable and the date by which it must be paid. That date will be at least 21 days after the decision is mailed.

Please keep this letter and quote the dispute reference if you contact us.

Customer Review Unit
Hethersound Bridge and Tunnel Authority
